title: UFOs shut down nuclear missiles

tellings.quote: I've I've interviewed a lot of those guys firsthand and I think they're all legit.

plain: UFOs are said to have appeared over US nuclear missile bases and shut down the missiles. Michels says he has interviewed many of the men who say they were there, firsthand, and that he thinks "they're all legit." If true, it would mean something unknown can switch off America's nuclear weapons.
